func TestBatchEvaluate_DisabledFlagPreservesOrderedResults(t *testing.T) {
	store := &storeMock{}
	s := &Server{logger: logger, store: store}

	store.On("GetFlag", mock.Anything, "enabled-first").
		Return(&flipt.Flag{Key: "enabled-first", Enabled: true}, nil).
		Run(func(mock.Arguments) { time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond) })
	store.On("GetEvaluationRules", mock.Anything, "enabled-first").
		Return([]*storage.EvaluationRule{}, nil)
	store.On("GetFlag", mock.Anything, "disabled").
		Return(&flipt.Flag{Key: "disabled", Enabled: false}, nil)
	store.On("GetFlag", mock.Anything, "enabled-last").
		Return(&flipt.Flag{Key: "enabled-last", Enabled: true}, nil)
	store.On("GetEvaluationRules", mock.Anything, "enabled-last").
		Return([]*storage.EvaluationRule{{
			ID:               "last-rule",
			FlagKey:          "enabled-last",
			SegmentKey:       "eligible",
			SegmentMatchType: flipt.MatchType_ALL_MATCH_TYPE,
		}}, nil)
	store.On("GetEvaluationDistributions", mock.Anything, "last-rule").
		Return([]*storage.EvaluationDistribution{}, nil)

	resp, err := s.BatchEvaluate(context.Background(), &flipt.BatchEvaluationRequest{
		RequestId: "batch-request",
		Requests: []*flipt.EvaluationRequest{
			{FlagKey: "enabled-first", EntityId: "entity-1"},
			{FlagKey: "disabled", EntityId: "entity-2"},
			{FlagKey: "enabled-last", EntityId: "entity-3"},
		},
	})

	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, resp)
	assert.Equal(t, "batch-request", resp.RequestId)
	require.Len(t, resp.Responses, 3)
	assert.True(t, resp.RequestDurationMillis > 0)

	for i, want := range []struct {
		flagKey  string
		entityID string
		disabled bool
		match    bool
	}{
		{"enabled-first", "entity-1", false, false},
		{"disabled", "entity-2", true, false},
		{"enabled-last", "entity-3", false, true},

func TestBatchEvaluate_DisabledFlagPreservesOrderedResults(t *testing.T) {
	store := &storeMock{}
	s := &Server{logger: logger, store: store}

	store.On("GetFlag", mock.Anything, "enabled-first").
		Return(&flipt.Flag{Key: "enabled-first", Enabled: true}, nil).
		Run(func(mock.Arguments) { time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond) })
	store.On("GetEvaluationRules", mock.Anything, "enabled-first").
		Return([]*storage.EvaluationRule{}, nil)
	store.On("GetFlag", mock.Anything, "disabled").
		Return(&flipt.Flag{Key: "disabled", Enabled: false}, nil)
	store.On("GetFlag", mock.Anything, "enabled-last").
		Return(&flipt.Flag{Key: "enabled-last", Enabled: true}, nil)
	store.On("GetEvaluationRules", mock.Anything, "enabled-last").
		Return([]*storage.EvaluationRule{{
			ID:               "last-rule",
			FlagKey:          "enabled-last",
			SegmentKey:       "eligible",
			SegmentMatchType: flipt.MatchType_ALL_MATCH_TYPE,
		}}, nil)
	store.On("GetEvaluationDistributions", mock.Anything, "last-rule").
		Return([]*storage.EvaluationDistribution{}, nil)

	resp, err := s.BatchEvaluate(context.Background(), &flipt.BatchEvaluationRequest{
		RequestId: "batch-request",
		Requests: []*flipt.EvaluationRequest{
			{FlagKey: "enabled-first", EntityId: "entity-1"},
			{FlagKey: "disabled", EntityId: "entity-2"},
			{FlagKey: "enabled-last", EntityId: "entity-3"},
		},
	})

	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, resp)
	assert.Equal(t, "batch-request", resp.RequestId)
	require.Len(t, resp.Responses, 3)
	assert.True(t, resp.RequestDurationMillis > 0)

	for i, want := range []struct {
		flagKey  string
		entityID string
		disabled bool
		match    bool
	}{
		{"enabled-first", "entity-1", false, false},
		{"disabled", "entity-2", true, false},
		{"enabled-last", "entity-3", false, true},
	} {
		got := resp.Responses[i]
		require.NotNil(t, got, "response %d", i)
		assert.Equal(t, want.flagKey, got.FlagKey)
		assert.Equal(t, want.entityID, got.EntityId)
		assert.Equal(t, want.disabled, got.Disabled)
		assert.Equal(t, want.match, got.Match)
		assert.Empty(t, got.RequestId)
		require.NotNil(t, got.Timestamp)
		assert.True(t, got.Timestamp.Seconds > 0, "response %d timestamp is unset", i)
		assert.True(t, got.RequestDurationMillis > 0, "response %d duration is unset", i)
		assert.True(t, got.RequestDurationMillis <= resp.RequestDurationMillis,
			"response %d duration exceeds batch duration", i)
	}

	assert.Empty(t, resp.Responses[1].SegmentKey)
	assert.Empty(t, resp.Responses[1].Value)
	assert.Equal(t, "eligible", resp.Responses[2].SegmentKey)
	assert.True(t, resp.Responses[2].RequestDurationMillis < resp.Responses[0].RequestDurationMillis,
		"later flag duration should exclude the first flag's 100 ms evaluation")

	encoded, err := protojson.Marshal(resp)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Contains(t, string(encoded), `"disabled":true`)
	var wireResponse struct {
		Responses []struct {
			FlagKey  string `json:"flagKey"`
			Disabled bool   `json:"disabled"`
		} `json:"responses"`
	}
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(encoded, &wireResponse))
	require.Len(t, wireResponse.Responses, 3)
	assert.Equal(t, "enabled-first", wireResponse.Responses[0].FlagKey)
	assert.Equal(t, "disabled", wireResponse.Responses[1].FlagKey)
	assert.True(t, wireResponse.Responses[1].Disabled)
	assert.Equal(t, "enabled-last", wireResponse.Responses[2].FlagKey)

	store.AssertNotCalled(t, "GetEvaluationRules", mock.Anything, "disabled")
	store.AssertExpectations(t)
}

Fixed `BatchEvaluate` so disabled flags produce ordered response entries instead of aborting the batch. Each entry includes its own timestamp and duration, and an explicit `disabled` field identifies disabled flags. The outer response retains the total duration.

Added `ErrDisabled` and `ErrDisabledf`, migrated protobuf timestamps and empty RPC responses to `google.golang.org/protobuf`, and added regression coverage. I delegated the evaluator, protobuf, and test changes, then integrated and reviewed them.

**Verification:** `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./... -count=1` passed.
